provenance: /home/tobias/Projects/initech-manuals-ref/dbase3plus/dBASE III Plus 1.1 (1986) Manuals/Using dBase III Plus.pdf printed U5-144, PDF 256, UNITCOST heading and first two values. /home/tobias/Projects/dbase3-decomp/mint/work/TOURS.DBF UNITCOST descriptor; evidence/CLIENTS-input.DBF BAL descriptor/record 2, offsets in evidence/dbf-input-fields.json.
